q: Comment on the following: Whether a Government Servant under suspension can prefer a request for voluntary retirement under Rule 48/48A of CCS(Pension) Rules,1972?

options.A: No. A Government Servant under suspension cannot prefer a request for voluntary retirement
options.B: Yes. It shall be open to the appointing authority to withhold permission to such Government servant to retire
options.C: Yes. Such request will be treated as in the case of a normal Govt.Servant
options.D: No. Suspension is a bar for preferring Voluntary retirement application

e: A Government servant under suspension CAN prefer a request for voluntary retirement under Rule 48/48-A of the CCS (Pension) Rules, 1972 — the request is not barred. The proviso to the rule, however, makes it open to the appointing authority to withhold permission to retire in such a case, so the retirement takes effect only if the authority allows it.
